annotations.title: Promote a memory into another workspace

description: Promote a memory into another workspace you belong to (from a private/personal workspace to a team). It is held for REVIEW there: the target workspace's agents do NOT recall or apply it until an owner of that workspace approves. target_space is the workspace to promote INTO (id or name from list_spaces); do not put it in `space`, which is the workspace you act from. Requires membership of both workspaces.

id.description: id is the memory (collection) id to promote.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act FROM (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

targetSpace.description:
target_space is the workspace to promote INTO (an id or name from
 list_spaces) - not your current space. You must belong to it.

name: promote_memory
title: Promote a memory into another workspace
